description: Adds a WiseWall section to the project's instructions file for one or more coding agents — CLAUDE.md (claude), .cursor/rules/wisewall.mdc (cursor), .windsurf/rules/wisewall.md (windsurf), .github/copilot-instructions.md (copilot), AGENTS.md (codex), GEMINI.md (gemini) — creating each file if it doesn't exist, appending to it otherwise, no-op per file if already present. Covers the same premium-gating and localStorage conventions described on set_config, but read automatically by an agent every session in this repo rather than only when a config tool happens to be in view. Defaults to all six clients, since a project isn't necessarily tied to whichever one is calling this tool right now — pass clients to scope it down. Writes the files directly. The hosted WiseWall MCP server exposes the same tool but, having no filesystem of its own, returns the exact content and file paths instead, for the calling agent to write itself.

clients.description: Which clients' instructions files to write. Defaults to all six.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project's root directory (not the build output/dist_dir).

name: init
title: Initialize project guidance
